name: NixOS - Minimal (latest systemd)
description: Minimal NixOS rootfs with basic packages and the systemd version pinned in the selected nixpkgs input. Runs on Kernel 5.10 and above only.

name: NixOS - Minimal (systemd v257)
description: Minimal NixOS rootfs with basic packages, built against the nixpkgs input carrying systemd v257. Runs on Kernel 5.10 and above only.

name: NixOS - Minimal (pinned systemd v257)
description: Minimal NixOS rootfs with basic packages, using the default nixpkgs input with systemd overridden to v257 and the unwanted container units disabled.

name: NixOS - Minimal (systemd v259)
description: Minimal NixOS rootfs with basic packages, built against the nixpkgs input carrying systemd v259. Upstream CI dropped this variant after it failed to build, so treat it as experimental.

name: finix - Experimental
description: Experimental Finix NixOS rootfs with basic packages, built from the finix community flake modules.
